edit.error: The relic wouldn't open. Check your signal and try again.

hand.heading: What's in your hand?
hand.sub: Hold something from the past. The rest can come later.

words.title: Words
words.hint: Write it down, or speak it and watch it appear.

voice.title: Voice
voice.hint: A minute of sound, kept in a shell.

photo.title: Photo
photo.hint: A plate, developed out of the dark.

letter.titlePlaceholder: Give it a name, if it has one
letter.bodyPlaceholder: Begin anywhere. Write it the way it comes back to you.

speak.label: Speak into the letter
speak.hint: Press and hold to speak and release to stop, or tap once to start and tap again to stop.

problem.denied: The microphone stayed closed. Hold the mic again and allow it, or write by hand.
problem.blocked: Relic can't use the microphone. You can open it in settings.
problem.unavailable: Speech to text isn't available on this phone. You can still write, or keep your voice as a recording.
problem.network: Speech needs a signal on this phone. Write by hand, or try again when you're connected.
problem.noSpeech: Nothing came through. Hold the mic closer and try again.

voice.title: Voice
voice.idle: Up to one minute. Tap to begin, tap to stop.
voice.blocked: Finish speaking into the letter first.
voice.kept: This relic already keeps its echo.

problem.denied: The microphone stayed closed. Allow it to record your voice.
problem.blocked: Relic can't use the microphone. You can open it in settings.
problem.tooShort: That was too short to keep. Try again.

photos.title: Plates · {{n}} of {{max}}
photos.full: A relic holds {{max}} plates, no more.

problem.cameraDenied: The camera stayed closed. Allow it to take a photo.
problem.cameraBlocked: Relic can't use the camera. You can open it in settings.
problem.failed: That photo wouldn't develop. Try another.

when.title: When did it happen?
when.hint: Scrub back as far as it goes. Anything before you joined belongs to The Before.

where.title: Where were you?
where.hint: A place, a street, a room. Or let the phone tell you.

who.title: Who was there?
who.hint: Names stay in your vault. Nobody is told.

weight.title: How heavy does it sit?
weight.hint: Drag between a feather and a stone.

light.title: Which lamp lights it?
light.hint: The lamp tints the relic's glow.

link.title: A video, kept as a reel
link.hint: Relic keeps the link, not the video.

seal.title: Seal it until…
seal.hint: A letter to whoever you'll be then.

when.label: Date of the memory
when.unregistered: An unregistered relic. Nobody up there will know it was ever kept. Down here, it is.

date.hint: Drag the ruler. Month and year marks carry their names.

where.label: Place
where.placeholder: A place, a street, a room
where.hereHint: Reads your location once and names the place
where.pinned: Coordinates are kept with the name.

problem.denied: Location stayed closed. Allow it, or type the place by hand.
problem.blocked: Relic can't read your location. You can open it in settings.
problem.off: Location is switched off on this phone. Type the place by hand.
problem.unnamed: Pinned the spot, but it has no name yet. Give it one to keep it.
problem.failed: Couldn't find the spot. Type the place by hand.

who.label: Add a name
who.private: Names stay in your vault. Nobody is told.
who.empty: The people you keep will gather here.
who.loading: Looking for the names you've kept…

weight.label: Weight of the memory
weight.effect: Heavier relics glow larger in the Vault and surface more often.

link.label: Video link
link.full: A relic holds {{max}} reels, no more.
link.hint: Only secure links (https) are kept. They open outside Relic.

problem.insecure: Only secure links starting with https:// can go on a reel.
problem.invalid: That doesn't look like a link.

seal.label: Seal this relic
seal.hint: Press and hold for about a second to seal it.
seal.needSomething: Put something in your hand first.
seal.overQuota: Your vault is too full for these plates.
seal.sealing: Sealing it. The Vault is receiving your relic.
seal.carrying_one: Carrying one piece of it down the shaft…
seal.carrying_other: Carrying {{count}} pieces of it down the shaft…
seal.explain: A sealed relic stays closed, even to you, until that day. A letter to whoever you'll be then.

problem.daily_limit: Five relics today. The vault rests until tomorrow.
problem.photo_limit: A relic holds five plates, no more. Take one away and try again.
problem.voice_limit: A relic holds one voice. This one already keeps its echo.
problem.voice_too_long: A voice relic holds a single minute. This one ran long; record it again.
problem.profile_missing: Your vault isn't ready yet. Give it a moment, then hold the seal again.
problem.quota: Your vault's lamp-oil is spent. The free vault holds 500 MB; release an older relic or take a plate away to make room.
problem.session: Your session ended. Sign in again to keep this relic.
problem.offline: No signal down here. Your letter is safe on this phone; hold the seal again when you're connected.
problem.unknown: Something slipped on the way down. Your letter is safe; hold the seal to try again.

leave.title: Leave it unsealed?
leave.body: This relic hasn't been kept yet. If you leave now, what you've added here is let go.
